insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new destination. The update is effective as of August 31, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure it accounts for the new tax recalculation behavior. This change may impact custom checkout or order management implementations. The orderUpdate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API is affected, so developers should test their code to ensure compatibility. Additionally, consider updating any relevant Webhooks or Shopify Functions to handle the changed tax calculations.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when shipping addresses are updated, which can impact their revenue and customer trust. This change ensures compliance with tax regulations and reduces the risk of incorrect tax charges.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to maintain compliance and build customer trust. This update ensures that Shopify's tax calculations remain reliable and adaptable to changes in orders.

themes.title: Hydrogen updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API updates
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem updates
themes.detail: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement. Merchants can also see partner details on collaborator requests, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated.
